svg.title: Five Resources, Five Shapes
svg.desc: Five radar charts side by side, ordered from the lowest total to the highest. Thin Material: quality 14, reusability 23, total 37, Weak, Reject. Watershed Basics: 32 and 33, total 65, Fair, Revise; a balanced, middling shape. Locked Chemistry E-book: 44 and 21, total 65, Fair, Revise; strong on the quality side and collapsed on the reusability side. One Gap: 45 and 40, total 85, Good, Revise; round except for one dent at portability. Open Algebra: 43 and 47, total 90, Excellent, Adopt; a large, even shape. A bracket joins the two charts with total 65 and reads same total, different shape.
svg.text: Ten metric scores per resource, from the lowest total to the highest. Illustrative examples from Chapter 3.
Each spoke runs from 0 at the center to 10 at the outer ring. Bands and decisions use the chapter's starting values.
